note: Track A/B failure family: temporal success→later failure (and controls) mis-read as contradiction. Same predicate as main lab. Includes seed BC_E1 / BC11_* ids for linkage plus new TF_* paraphrases. Synthetic notes only.

cases.why: Clear first-line R-CHOP failure then switch to second line — not a contradiction.
cases.evidence: DLBCL: first-line R-CHOP for four cycles with initial response, then radiographic progression in cycle 5. Discontinued R-CHOP for progression; started R-ICE as second-line therapy.

cases.why: Paraphrase of response→progression on first-line; gold SATISFIED.
cases.evidence: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma. Patient completed cycles 1–3 of first-line R-CHOP with partial metabolic response. During cycle 4, PET showed new FDG-avid nodes. R-CHOP was stopped because of disease progression and second-line R-ICE was started.

cases.why: Initial stable disease on first-line then clear progression and regimen change.
cases.evidence: Metastatic NSCLC on first-line pembrolizumab/pemetrexed: imaging after two cycles showed stable disease. Restaging at cycle 5 demonstrated progressive osseous metastases. First-line therapy discontinued for progression; switched to docetaxel.

cases.why: Linked to BC11_E1 pattern — response then biochemical progression.
cases.evidence: Multiple myeloma: first-line RVd produced a partial response after three cycles, then rising M-protein and new lesions at cycle 4. Held lenalidomide for progression; started daratumumab-based second-line therapy.

cases.why: Ibrutinib response then Richter progression; Ph11 steer miss candidate.
cases.evidence: CLL: first-line ibrutinib with initial nodal response, then Richter transformation with bulky adenopathy at month 9. Discontinued ibrutinib for progression; switched to R-CHOP.

cases.why: Possible progression later confirmed; first-line stopped for confirmed failure.
cases.evidence: Follicular lymphoma on first-line bendamustine-rituximab: mid-treatment note raised possible progression. Confirmatory PET two weeks later showed clear progressive disease. Bendamustine-rituximab stopped for confirmed progression; second-line therapy planned.

cases.why: Early imaging negative for progression; later imaging positive — sequence, not contradiction.
cases.evidence: Colon cancer on first-line FOLFOX: CT after cycle 3 showed no progression. CT after cycle 6 showed new hepatic metastases. FOLFOX discontinued for progression; started FOLFIRI.

cases.why: Possible progression only; confirmatory scan pending — must not AUTO failure.
cases.evidence: DLBCL on first-line R-CHOP cycle 3: possible new adenopathy on exam. PET scheduled next week; no regimen change until imaging returns.

cases.why: Stopped first-line for toxicity while disease controlled — not therapy failure.
cases.evidence: Breast cancer on first-line paclitaxel: tumor markers falling and imaging stable. Paclitaxel stopped for grade 3 neuropathy. Plan alternate first-line partner agent; no progression documented.

cases.why: Later toxicity after early tolerance; disease still responding — not first-line failure.
cases.evidence: AML on first-line 7+3: cycles 1 tolerated without major toxicity and day-14 marrow showed response. Cycle 2 complicated by culture-positive sepsis requiring ICU. Induction held for toxicity; marrow still without progression.

cases.why: Same workup denies vs documents completed first-line — true contradiction.
cases.evidence: CAR-T intake: patient reports never receiving systemic chemotherapy for DLBCL. Same-day oncology addendum: completed six cycles of first-line R-CHOP with subsequent progression; proceed to apheresis.

cases.why: Seed true contradiction from Phase-7 set.
cases.evidence: CAR-T referral intake (14 Jan 2024): patient reports never receiving systemic chemotherapy for DLBCL. Lymphoma clinic note (22 Mar 2024): completed six cycles of first-line R-CHOP, then PET showed progressive nodal disease; relapsed/refractory DLBCL.

cases.why: Ongoing first-line with response; no failure event.
